digest.component_or_area: authorship fixture and batched commit map resolution
propositions: The fixture-level equivalence test incorrectly assumed build_ticket_position_commit_map would return a complete map on first attempt, but the function explicitly fails closed to {} on any Git nonzero result, empty output, or process exception.

Runtime injections of rc 128 with empty stderr, rc 0 with empty stdout, and BlockingIOError(EAGAIN) each reproduced the observed sequence: first batched call returns {}, immediate replay of identical arguments against unchanged repository returns all 8 entries.

Deletion of the previously implicated loose blob 66842fd0... left both broad and narrow git history reads healthy, refuting the prior ENOENT/missing-loose-object hypothesis as the cause of the Gerrit 1827 batched-empty recurrence.
The test harness lacked bounded Git-read recovery already established in tests/_git_counts.py, requiring at most five exact resolver attempts and persistent-failure diagnostics.
